sources.text: Search this site Embedded Files SMALL@UCSD Welcome to SMALL Li Research Group @ UCSD Department of Chemistry Li Research Group @ UCSD Chemistry SMALL RESEARCH MAKES BIG DIFFERENCES Welcome to explore " SMALL ": S pectroscopy and M icroscopy at A tomic L evel L aboratory. We combine femtosecond laser and scanning tunneling microscope to study the quantum phenomena which occurs at nearly the smallest length scale and the fastest time scale. Find out more Latest News: 08/07/2026. Liya Bi received the 2026 AVS National Graduate Research Award . 0 8 / 05 /2026. Our new paper, " Atomic-Scale Imaging and Characterization of Colloidally Synthesized Gold Nanocubes Using Scanning Tunneling Microscopy " is published in Journal of the American Chemical Society . 0 7 /01/2026. Shaowei Li is promoted to Associate Professor with tenure and appointed as the Yinan Wang Memorial Chancellor's Endowed Junior Faculty Fellow . 06 / 17 /2026. Our new paper, "Engineering Structural Transitions in a Multi-Level Molecular Switch via Intermolecular Coupling" is highlighted as the Front Cover in Journal of the American Chemical Society . 04/2 9 /2026. Kangkai Liang has been recognized as the third-place finalist for the 2026 Abe Hurlich Scholarship. 04/24/2026. Liya Bi received the Outstanding Researcher Award in Materials Science and Engineering. 02/19/2026. Our new paper, "Single-Molecule Infrared Spectroscopy with Scanning Tunneling Microscopy", is published in Science . and featured on UCSD Today , Phys.org , Engineeringness , Wiley A nalytical S cience , Technologynetwor ks , Mirage News , National Today , and ScienceBlog . 01/01/2026. Shaowei has joined the Editorial Advisory Board of the Journal of Physical Chemistry A / B / C . Report abuse Page details Page updated Report abuse
